migrationNotes: The current Google Form routes result type from the final vision question only.
A native quiz should support multi-question scoring rather than relying on one branching question.
Lead capture should be privacy-conscious and explain how quiz/contact data will be used.
Booking should eventually route to a controlled booking/payment flow instead of Instagram bio only.
